author: toketrain
body:
I've seen in some yml "contributor"

I got a few q's cause I wanna add someone as a contributor.

1. Is this allowed for normal players?

2. How do you write it in exactly?

3. Does it show up in the chat when it normally shows only "created by"?

thank much for any help

title: Contributor

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
1. Yeah, you're free to add contributors to your map's YML if you wish.

2. It's the same format as 'creators', it should go like this:
creators:
- Spock404
contributors:
- Evocal

3. No, contributors are not displayed in the chat when that message pops up.
